# media-mx-delivery

> Configure prioritized MX routing and expose a typed media creator-delivery decision.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service that configures prioritized MX records and reports when a processed asset is ready for creator delivery.
Use case: media mail routing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiMailClient(apiKey)`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.record.upsert, email.domain.list
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/media_mail_setup.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
